title: Sheet to HDC Character IR (version 2)
description: The contract between reading a sheet and scripts/build-hdc.mjs. Costs are the sheet's: the builder checks Hero Designer's pricing against them and score-hdc.mjs reports every difference. Version 1 fields (hdcXmlId, levels, modifiers and adders as objects) are still accepted for powers without build text.

source.description: The workbook the IR was read from

magicSkill.description: The skill spells' Requires A Magic Roll rolls against (a Power skill's name), when the text doesn't name one

sheetTotal.description: The points the sheet says the character spends; the scorer compares against it

warnings.description: Sheet arithmetic that doesn't add up, house rules, and every judgment call a reader should know about

maxima.description: Characteristic maxima, only when the sheet's rules turn them on (levels above them cost double)

free.description: Not in the sheet's point total (cost multiplier 0)

xmlId.description: Hero Designer's skill (STEALTH, KNOWLEDGE_SKILL, POWERSKILL, LANGUAGES, COMBAT_LEVELS, WEAPON_FAMILIARITY, CUSTOMSKILL...) or enhancer (SCHOLAR, LINGUIST, SCIENTIST, WELL_CONNECTED)

input.description: The subject: KS/PS/SS topic, language, Power skill type

levels.description: Bought levels; worked out from points when absent

option.description: Combat/Skill Levels breadth (SINGLE, TIGHT, HTH, RANGED, ALL)

attacks.description: Combat Skill Levels: the attacks they apply to

weapons.description: Weapon Familiarity groups (Common Melee Weapons, Blades, Bows...)

xmlId.description: CONTACT, REPUTATION, FAVOR, FOLLOWER, VEHICLE_BASE, FRINGE_BENEFIT, MONEY, CUSTOMPERK...

roll.description: Contact roll (8- 1 level, 11- 2, +1 each after) or Reputation's how well known

detail.description: Contact adders in words (useful / very useful skills or resources, contacts of his own, access to institutions, good relationship, slavishly loyal); Reputation group size

type.description: Hero Designer XMLID (HUNTED, PSYCHOLOGICALLIMITATION, VULNERABILITY...) or editor type (PSYCHOLOGICAL_COMPLICATION...)

detail.description: Include the frequency and intensity words (Uncommon, Strong, 1 1/2 x BODY): the writer picks Hero Designer's options from them and the points

build.description: HERO build text: "RKA 2d6, Armor Piercing (+¼); OAF (staff; -1), Requires A Roll (Wizardry; -½)"

defense.description: Attacks: the defense they work against

skillRoll.description: The skill a Requires A Roll uses, when the text doesn't say

custom.description: Build a custom power named by the text (priced from the sheet)

prefab.description: Copy this item from the --prefabs library instead

reserve.description: A Multipower's reserve or a pool's size
